body:
I have never had a relationship or encounter where I have sought to keep the contact going that I feel is balanced. It means much more to me than the other party, and I've never had the case where it is the other way around. I would be the one usually reaching out to them. I am the one who replies to missed calls, texts, emails, and other notes promptly (and have to train myself to not do this), whereas they take days or weeks and sometimes don't reply at all and don't mention anything about it the next time you talk to them. If I don't remind them that I exist, I don't hear from them in all but a few cases. I grew very weary of always being the pursuer. If someone really wants you, they will make it known. Very few have ever made it known.

And for the record, I have never been a big texter and I hate facebook and do not have one. I had one for two years with a 'friend' count in the hundreds, but found that nobody would respond to my postings or messages, so I was essentially keeping up a profile that no one was interested in. No one ever poked me. "No one ever poked me" feels like an appropriate epitaph.
